about_the_game:
RPG CHESS - A TURN-BASED RPG, EXCEPT IT'S ALSO CHESS!

Step into a world where every chess move is a potential battle for glory. RPG Chess reimagines the classic game of chess as an epic turn-based RPG adventure, combining strategy, combat, and other beloved RPG elements in a way you've never experienced before!

FEATURES:

  • Strategic Chess Gameplay with an RPG Twist:
    Every attack initiates a battle! Instead of capturing pieces, you’ll enter intense 1v1 combat sequences where your piece must fight for victory. The outcome depends on your strategy, piece level, and skill in battle. While the attacker gets the first move, the targeted piece finally gets to fight back!

  • Piece Progression and Leveling:

    Each time a piece moves or secures victory in combat, it gains valuable experience points. Level up your pieces to unlock classes, elements, abilities and more. You can create a queen that specializes in powerful fire spells, a knight that uses the wind to alter the board, or even turn a humble pawn into an unstoppable warrior. You choose the path of your pieces, allowing you to craft your dream team and adapt to the situation on the board!

  • Immersive Single-Player Adventure:

    Lead your pieces through a grand journey across diverse boards and environments in Adventure Mode. Face off against increasingly challenging opponents, each encounter demanding strategic mastery and adaptability. As you progress, your pieces retain their levels and abilities, creating unique synergies and powerful builds with every run. Use the gold you earn from battles to recruit new pieces or acquire powerful artifacts, all to aid you in your quest to reclaim your throne.

  • Battle Your Friends:

    Challenge your friends to intense 1v1 matches online or gather around for local multiplayer-mode. Outsmart, outplay, and earn your bragging rights, whether you're across the internet or side by side.

  • Customize Your Pieces:

    Express the personality of your army with a variety of customization options. Unlock unique hats to give each piece extra flair, and give them personal nicknames to make every battle feel uniquely yours.

BUILD YOUR ARMY. MASTER THE BOARD. EXCEL IN COMBAT.

Forge your path as a tactician and warrior in RPG Chess. Every battle shapes your pieces and brings you closer to triumph.

Ready to experience chess in an exciting new way? Add RPG Chess to your wishlist today!
